description:
Senior Recruiter – Global Talent Acquisition

Location: Remote, based in the United States

Reports to: Head of HR

Focus: GTM and customer success hiring first, technology hiring as needed

About UptimeAI

UptimeAI is transforming industrial operations through its AI-driven platform that maximizes uptime, optimizes asset performance and enhances reliability across heavy industries. Our AI Reasoning Engine and AI Expert platform combine advanced data science, deep learning and decades of domain expertise to help plants predict, diagnose and resolve issues in real time. UptimeAI is a fast-growing company expanding across North America and the Middle East, with recognition and partnerships from Shell, Mitsubishi, ABB Motion and Frost & Sullivan.

The opportunity

Own recruiting for UptimeAI’s US hiring, with Middle East roles alongside. Your priority is to find, assess and close top go-to-market (sales, partnerships and solutions) and customer success talent in the US, and to support our technology hiring as and when needed. You will work directly with senior leaders, build a hiring process that runs on clear data, and work alongside our India recruiter. You will report to the Head of HR.

Key responsibilities

  • Run end-to-end recruiting for US roles, with Middle East (UAE, Oman and nearby markets) roles alongside: intake, sourcing, screening, interviews, offers and onboarding.

  • Lead hiring for our priority GTM and customer success roles, such as Account Executives, Account and Partner Managers, Sales Consultants and Solutions Engineers, and customer success and implementation roles. Support technology hiring (engineering, data and AI) as and when needed.

  • Source passive, senior and niche candidates through direct search, LinkedIn Recruiter, networks, referrals and communities; build and maintain talent pipelines.

  • Run intake with hiring managers: agree the profile, scorecard, timeline and interview loop; keep them updated with a weekly status.

  • Manage Ashby (or similar ATS) as the single source of truth: keep pipelines current, requisitions accurate and data clean.

  • Report weekly hiring metrics: funnel conversion, source mix, time-to-shortlist, time-to-fill, offer acceptance and pipeline coverage; flag risks early.

  • Manage offers and closing: compensation conversations covering base, variable pay or commission and equity, counter-offers, and start date and notice follow-up, in line with each country’s practice.

  • Follow fair and compliant US hiring practice, including equal employment opportunity, pay transparency and work authorization basics, working with our HR team.

  • Prioritize across competing requisitions and communicate trade-offs clearly with business leaders.

  • Drive the employee referral program: share hot roles, screen referrals quickly and keep referrers updated.

  • Manage freelance sourcers or search partners when needed; keep candidate experience strong.

  • Share market and compensation insight with HR leadership.

Must have

  • 7–10 years of recruiting experience, including 4+ years of end-to-end hiring in the US market.

  • Direct experience hiring go-to-market (sales, partnerships or solutions) and customer success talent, and willingness to take on technology hiring as needed.

  • Proven sourcing skill for passive, senior and niche talent.

  • Hands-on experience with an ATS such as Ashby, Greenhouse, Lever or similar.

  • Excellent hiring data management: funnel metrics, dashboards and clean, current records.

  • Strong stakeholder management with senior business leaders; able to prioritize, push back with data and keep managers informed.

  • Offer negotiation and closing experience, including US compensation structures (base, variable pay or commission, and equity).

  • Based in the United States and able to work remotely, with some flexibility to overlap with India and Middle East time zones for team meetings.

  • Strong written and verbal communication; self-directed and comfortable in a lean team.

Preferred

  • Experience in industrial software, AI, analytics, APM or SaaS (UptimeAI’s industry).

  • Direct Ashby experience.

  • Experience hiring technology roles (engineering, data or AI).

  • Hiring experience in the UAE, Oman or Saudi Arabia.

  • Experience building or running employee referral programs.

  • Experience in a Series A–C or high-growth company.

Key success metrics

Time-to-shortlist · Time-to-fill · Offer acceptance rate · Source mix and referral share · Pipeline coverage · Funnel conversion · Hiring-manager satisfaction · Candidate experience

Working hours and location

This is a remote, US-based role. Working hours are flexible, with regular overlap with US business hours and occasional overlap with the Middle East and India (our Head of HR is based in India). The schedule will be agreed with the selected candidate.

Compensation

US base salary range: [to be added before posting]. The package also includes stock options. Details are shared during the interview process.

Why join UptimeAI

Be the first dedicated recruiter for our US go-to-market and customer success teams at a fast-growing Industrial AI company: build the hiring process as we scale, work directly with company leaders, and see the impact of every hire on our growth.

UptimeAI is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and make employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status or any other protected characteristic.
